cohort: 274 neonates with omphalocele born between 2005 and 2013 at nine centers in the United States
finding: The study, encompassing a large cohort of neonates with omphalocele, identifies increased defect size as an independent predictor of neonatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: The majority of neonates with omphaloceles were delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Birth weight was an independent predictor of survival.
